_what: Every closed list (z.enum / z.literal / z.nativeEnum) an agent tool's input accepts, keyed by file and declaring line, with why the set is the agent's own vocabulary rather than a name it must guess (AI-1l). Enforced by tests/sop/tool-input-constraints.test.ts: a new list fails until reasoned here; a removed one fails until its row goes.

constraints.src/features/ai/server/actionDescriptors: HTTP verbs, the agent's own vocabulary. GET is left out on purpose: this is the ERP WRITE tool, and reads have their own.
The ERP ownership rule's two modes in our own model (a product attribute, or whole websites); a third mode would be a new feature, not a different name.
Commerce configuration scopes this tool writes: default, or the project's own website. Commerce's own words for them; store-view scope is deliberately not offered.
The setup checklist's own three step states, defined by this extension; the tool's description says what each means.
Discriminator of assign_erp_products' selection: a brand as buyers see it. Our own shape.
Discriminator of assign_erp_products' selection: chooses which field the selection carries (a category id). Our own shape, documented beside each branch.
Discriminator of assign_erp_products' selection: the start of the SKUs. Our own shape.
Discriminator of assign_erp_products' selection: a list of SKUs. Our own shape.
constraints.src/features/ai/server/dataInstallerDesc: Demo Builder's own two datapack stores: the Data Installer service's catalog and the team's datapack library. Not a name the agent must guess; the description says which is the default.
Demo Builder's own two datapack stores: the Data Installer service's catalog and the team's datapack library. Not a name the agent must guess; the description says which is the default.
constraints.src/features/ai/server/lifecycleTools.ts: Which of the current project's own URLs to open; arbitrary URLs are refused by design (the tool takes over the screen). The description lists every target with what it opens.
constraints.src/features/ai/server/readDescriptors.t: The data installer's own four operations for process-datapack (import, export, delete, validate). The service names them so; there is no other spelling an agent could reach for.
constraints.src/features/ai/server/viewTools.ts: vie: Demo Builder's own screens (VIEW_COMMANDS). The set IS the screens that exist; a name outside it opens nothing, and the description lists them.
